note: Rockstar newswire 3 Nov 2026 15:00Z 'Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Begins on November 10' (page not fetchable here; rockstargames.com/VI banner read: Pre-Load Begins November 10, Coming November 19, 2026) via VGC 15:02Z: PS5 midnight local time on 10 Nov in each time zone; Xbox Series X|S 10 Nov 12am GMT (4pm PT 9 Nov); code-in-box versions 12 Nov; release 19 Nov. Dubai times are our conversion (UTC+4): Xbox 04:00, PS5 00:00. 212 GB size reported by IGN, TweakTown and others, kept out of the Reel. Footage: Rockstar press-kit Launch Trailer 4K (media.rockstargames.com download), clean shots only (no weapons, no intimate scenes).
